title: Ghost Murmur quantum sensor detects a soldier's heartbeat

tellings.quote: And he was I think he needed to be rescued and they detected his heartbeat via this quantum sensing modality.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a device called Ghost Murmur, a quantum sensor, meaning an instrument that uses the strange physics of tiny particles to pick up extremely faint signals, linked to the defence company Lockheed Martin. He says that in the 2020s a soldier in the Middle East, in Iran or Afghanistan, needed rescuing, and the sensor found him by detecting his heartbeat. Michels raises it in an episode with a whistleblower, as a hint of how far hidden technology may have advanced.
